Anchor oracle sensitivity: 3 placeholder-vs-hyperlink distinctions retained.

Link grammar: 22 supplemental reference and exact-source checks.

Explicit paragraph-source flow: 8 LF/CRLF exact-code/source contracts; 2 full structural matches. Outer-div mismatches retained; 4 structural fixture kinds still declined.
Explicit structural source flow: 58 LF/CRLF reference-code/source contracts. Paragraphs, headings, code, plain hard breaks and list/quote nesting supported; outer-div mismatches remain. Separate contracts cover protected Markdown images/rules and pipe tables; specialized unsupported blocks still refuse conversion.
Structural source flow: 44 LF/CRLF full reference-structure and exact-source contracts outside pre.
Entity newlines: 12 reference text-character and canonical round-trip contracts passed.

Table projection: unit spans/cell wrappers equivalent; 14 structural/content corruptions rejected.
Formatting scopes: 20 reference semantic/source contracts; 10 corruptions rejected.
Inline block HTML: 2 existing literal fallbacks retained, explicitly not counted as conformance.
Paragraph recovery: 76 opt-in reference/source contracts; existing baselines unchanged.

Reference parser reproduced all 652 official HTML outputs exactly.
Inert raw HTML: 72/72 semantic, 72/72 exact token contracts; 144/144 generated boundary/round-trip contracts.

Opt-in HTML block + inline semantics: 579/652 exact neutral-projection matches; remaining differences unresolved, not full conformance.
Optional HTML containers: 26 reference-semantic and 26 exact-source checks; existing schema/profile scores unchanged.
Opt-in source recovery: 580/652 neutral-projection matches on LF and CRLF; 1304 separate exact-source checks. Not full CommonMark conformance.

Complete source retention diagnostics: 1298/1304 exact safe-HTML model reopens; source model statuses {"equal-except-source-tokens":1292,"different":12}. Neither is body semantic conformance.

Explicit complete source body without Markdown caret children: 648/652 on both line endings.
